gui.jumpdelayfix.desc.profile: Cycle the manual profile used for jump timing. Picking a profile manually also turns off auto profile switching until you enable it again.
gui.jumpdelayfix.desc.auto: Lets the mod watch rollback history and swap between profiles automatically for the current server.
